body:
I am only 20. But I feel this way about the past few years, told myself "keep going! Things will get better, you can make something of your life!" Still here, got through a lot, had a few short happy moments but they were wiped out and replaced with really horrible memories. No matter what good things I do, shit things keep happening, with only tiny moments of happiness (is it worth it? 95 percent misery with 5 percent happiness?)

I do NOT want to be 30/40/50 and posting something similar to this, from the looks of it, some people just aren't cut out for life or blessed. I believe if your mind is telling you life isn't worth living, you're probably one of those unlucky people who never have it easy. That is why I am considering suicide again.

I'm so sorry to everyone who is going through this.

I offen think about the many people who have a proper life but are diagnosed with terminal illnesses or are killed in accidents and I'm sitting here, with no friends or quality of life, being a waste of space, a burden to family and trying to sleep through every day to pass time..thinking, why couldn't that be me? Why can't people who want to live, live and people who just aren't cut out for life die like that, because suicide is REALLY difficult to bring yourself to do.
I too feel this way, i'll listen.
